mapper.update: UPDATE erp_time_table SET yy = #{dto.yy}, mm = #{dto.mm}, dayname = #{dto.dayname}, period_no = #{dto.periodNo}, start_time = #{dto.startTime}, end_time = #{dto.endTime}, class_key = #{dto.classKey}, unit_key = #{dto.unitKey}, grade_key = #{dto.gradeKey}, user_code = #{dto.userCode}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.select: SELECT c.class_type, c.class_key, t.center_code, t.user_code FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key where time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_attendance (student_id, attendance_key, time_table_key, center_code, week, created_at) SELECT #{studentId} AS student_id, 'before' AS attendance_key, #{timeTableKey} AS time_table_key, #{centerCode} AS center_code, w.week AS week, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS created_at FROM (VALUES ('ju_1'), ('ju_2'), ('ju_3'), ('ju_4')) AS w(week) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} AND sa.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = w.week);
mapper.select: SELECT time_table_key AS timeTableKey, period_no AS periodNo, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, yy AS yy, mm AS mm, dayname AS dayname, tt.class_key AS classKey, tt.unit_key AS unitKey, cc.class_type AS classType, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, G.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName FROM erp_time_table tt JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key WHERE yy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY dayname, period_no

SELECT st.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, tta.week AS week FROM erp_time_table_assign tta JOIN erp_student st ON tta.student_id = st.student_id WHERE tta.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} ORDER BY st.student_name

SELECT tt.id as timeTableId, tt.time_table_key as timeTableKey, tt.period_no as periodNo, tt.start_time as startTime, tt.end_time as endTime, tt.yy as yy, tt.mm as mm, tt.dayname as dayname, cc.class_name as className, uc.unit_name as unitName, g.grade_name as gradeName FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE tt JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON tt.user_code = u.user_code WHERE tt.yy = #{year} and tt.mm = #{month} and tt.period_no = #{periodNo} and tt.dayname = #{dayname} and tt.user_code = #{userCode}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.app_token AS appToken, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_ym AS ym, t.class_key AS classKey, t.unit_key AS unitKey, sa.week AS week, sa.in_time AS inTime, sa.out_time AS outTime, ac.attendance_name AS attendanceName, sa.is_before_send AS isBeforeSend, sa.is_after_send AS isAfterSend, r.absence_date AS absenceDate, r.remedial_date AS remedialDate, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, s.center_code AS centerCode
FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE t JOIN ERP_TIME_TABLE_CODE tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key JOIN ERP_TIME_TABLE_ASSIGN ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN ERP_STUDENT s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_STUDENT_ATTENDANCE sa ON s.student_id = sa.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_ATTENDANCE_CODE ac ON sa.attendance_key = ac.attendance_key LEFT JOIN ERP_REMEDIAL r ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND t.time_table_key = r.time_table_key WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = #{week}

SELECT CASE #{week} WHEN 'ju_1' THEN bc.ju_1 WHEN 'ju_2' THEN bc.ju_2 WHEN 'ju_3' THEN bc.ju_3 WHEN 'ju_4' THEN bc.ju_4 ELSE bc.ju_1 END AS content, bc.before_class_key AS beforeClassKey, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_label AS timeTableLabel, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_before_class bc JOIN erp_time_table t ON bc.class_key = t.class_key AND bc.unit_key = t.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key WHERE t.unit_key = #{unitKey} AND t.class_key = #{classKey} AND t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}

SELECT * FROM erp_remedial r JOIN erp_student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_user u ON r.user_code = u.user_code WHERE r.user_code = 'DAE001cos' AND substring(r.absence_date, 1, 4) = #{year} AND substring(r.absence_date, 6, 2) = #{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_remedial SET action = #{action}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
UPDATE erp_remedial SET remedial_date = #{remedialDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, t.time_table_key, m.question1, m.question2, m.question3, m.question4, m.question5, m.question6, m.question7, m.question8 FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_monthly_score m ON m.time_table_key = t.time_table_key AND m.student_id = ta.student_id WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_monthly_score SET question1 = #{score.question1}, question2 = #{score.question2}, question3 = #{score.question3}, question4 = #{score.question4}, question5 = #{score.question5}, question6 = #{score.question6}, question7 = #{score.question7}, question8 = #{score.question8}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND time_table_key = #{classCode} AND yy = #{yy} AND mm = #{mm}
mapper.select:
SELECT CASE c.class_type WHEN '1' THEN 'S' WHEN '2' THEN 'I' ELSE c.class_type END AS gubun, CASE t.dayname WHEN 'mon' THEN '월' WHEN 'tue' THEN '화' WHEN 'wed' THEN '수' WHEN 'thu' THEN '목' WHEN 'fri' THEN '금' WHEN 'sat' THEN '토' WHEN 'sun' THEN '일' ELSE t.dayname END AS dayname, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR (5), t.start_time, 108), ':', '') AS stime, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR (5), t.end_time, 108), ':', '') AS etime, t.mm, c.class_name + ' ' + u.unit_name AS note FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code u ON t.unit_key = u.unit_key WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm}
order by stime ASC

SELECT cc.class_type AS classType, t.yy AS yy, t.mm AS mm, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, t.dayname AS dayname, t.start_time AS startTime, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON t.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_before_class_notice(student_id, time_table_key, week, dayname, class_time, class_date, class_type, class_label, content, user_code, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{timeTableKey}, #{week}, #{dayname}, #{classTime}, #{classDate}, #{classType}, #{classLabel}, #{content}, #{userCode}, SYSDATETIME())

INSERT INTO erp_after_class_notice(student_id, user_code, time_table_key, after_class_key, week, dayname, year, month, class_type, class_label, content, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{userCode}, #{timeTableKey}, 'EGH0060425', #{week}, #{dayname}, #{year}, #{month}, #{classType}, #{classLabel}, #{content}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT TOP(#{count}) class_type AS gubun, class_label AS note, CASE dayname WHEN 'mon' THEN '월' WHEN 'tue' THEN '화' WHEN 'wed' THEN '수' WHEN 'thu' THEN '목' WHEN 'fri' THEN '금' WHEN 'sat' THEN '토' WHEN 'sun' THEN '일' ELSE dayname END AS dayname, class_date AS ymd, class_time AS studytime, content AS prequest FROM erp_before_class_notice WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC;

SELECT class_type AS gubun, class_label AS title, dayname AS dayname, week AS ju, [year] AS yyyy, [month] AS mm, content AS snote FROM erp_after_class_notice WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC;
